stance_rationale: Forge's do-not-deploy conclusion for HMM overlay is directionally supported by the same-period M4 baseline comparison, but the package is not acceptance-ready. Pure Function hash evidence is internally inconsistent, Harvey/DSR gates are absent, and turnover is reported without the mandated round-trip x2 convention.

critical_concerns.description: Pure Function evidence is not reliable: forge_package_draft weights_csv_sha256 is eb0e56... but current weights.csv sha256 is 144fee..., hash_integrity_check omits alpha/risk/optimization package pre/post md5s, and input_hashes_start.md5 conflicts with current weights/HMM_Scale/optimization_package hashes.
Harvey 5-spec and DSR gates are absent. The package marks lockbox harvey_threshold_pass using n=28, but no CAPM/Carhart-3/Carhart-4/FF5/FF6 t_NW, alpha_monthly, or DSR outputs are present.
Turnover is under-reported versus the role checklist: Forge reports Annual_Turnover = mean(|delta w_str|)*12 = 0.3367 for canonical, while RF-F7 requires round-trip x2, approximately 0.6734.

The user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-S20260504_003 path and alpha_scores.parquet are missing, so alpha_sig_dates_count=267 cannot be independently tied to a Date x Ticker x score_* alpha time series.

Lockbox sealing is ambiguous: charts continue after 2024-01, but no frozen pre-lockbox parameter or buy-and-hold extension audit is provided, and the package uses 2024-01-01 rather than the sealed 2024-01-23 lockbox boundary.
Package-artifact metric integrity is not clean: forge_package_draft reports S1 Total_Return 3391.59, while lro_performance_summary.csv reports 2937.5584 for the same S1 strategy.

Same-period baseline is materially better than a documented-baseline citation, but baseline fairness remains incomplete because the same DSR penalty was not applied to canonical and M4_baseline_recomputed.

supporting_arguments: weights.csv is not a single snapshot: 267 unique Date rows from 2004-01-01 to 2026-03-01, sum weights = 1, long-only at sleeve level.
Equity, annual returns, and OOS zoom charts are present; the strategy line remains visible after the lockbox marker.
M4_baseline_recomputed is same-period and same-cost at the Forge harness level, and it dominates canonical M4+HMM on CAGR and Sharpe with identical MDD.
covariance.parquet exists under stage_artifacts and is PSD with worst condition number 11.364988, below the <=100 post-shrink check.
unresolved_disputes: Whether qepm/stage_artifacts is mandatory or stage_artifacts/WT_WT-S20260504_003 is the accepted canonical path.
Whether sizing_only alpha inheritance can waive alpha_scores.parquet time-series verification for this Forge review.
Whether lockbox evaluation must use frozen pre-2024-01-23 HMM parameters rather than walk-forward refits through the lockbox period.
Whether the sleeve turnover convention may be one-way for cost while the reporting gate explicitly requires round-trip x2.
Whether MONITORING_ONLY recommendation can omit Harvey/DSR gates; under the role prompt it cannot.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is hash_audit_pass=true: the audit does not prove 3-package Pure Function immutability and conflicts with current artifact/package hashes.
rebuttal_required: Regenerate Pure Function audit with pre/post md5 for alpha_package, risk_package, optimization_package, weights.csv, and all variant weights; reconcile sha256 fields.
Add Harvey 5-spec results with t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR for canonical and M4_baseline_recomputed.
Apply a consistent candidates_tried penalty to both canonical and baseline DSR.
Report round-trip annual turnover using x2 and explain any separate one-way cost convention.
Provide alpha_scores.parquet or a formal inheritance hash mapping parent alpha sig_dates to the 267 weight dates.
Provide a lockbox frozen-extension audit using the 2024-01-23 sealed boundary.
rationalization_red_flags: recommendation-only nature ... deployment decision rests with Q-Lead

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge's negative deployment recommendation is useful, but it cannot count as an AX-008 PASS until hash integrity, Harvey/DSR, turnover, alpha schedule, and lockbox evidence are corrected.

Lockbox period strategy NAV가 equity_curve에 visible한가?
